image_description: A close-up, underwater shot of the head and rostrum of a grey whale. The image highlights the textured, mottled grey skin covered in barnacles (white patches) and cyamids. The arched upper jaw and lower jaw are visible, showing the characteristic shape of the species' head. The background is murky green water.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture clearly shows the characteristic grey coloration with scattered white spots consistent with barnacle attachments.
